data.name: Sample - Proofpoint TAP - 1.0.2
data.description: Sample playbooks for "Proofpoint TAP" connector. If you are planning to use any of the sample playbooks in your environment, ensure that you clone those playbooks and move them to a different collection, since the sample playbook collection gets deleted during connector upgrade and delete.

workflows.name: Get Forensic Details
workflows.description: Get forensic details for provided threat or campaign.

workflows.name: Get Blocked Threat Message Events
workflows.description: Fetch events for messages blocked in the specified time period which contained a known threat.

routes.name: Get Blocked Messages Events -> Save Response

workflows.name: Get Delivered Threat Message Events
workflows.description: Fetch events for messages delivered in the specified time period which contained a known threat.

routes.name: Get Delivered Messages Events -> Save response

workflows.name: Get Events for All Issues
workflows.description: Fetch events for clicks to malicious URLs permitted and messages delivered containing a known attachment threat within the specified time period.

workflows.name: > Proofpoint Event Fetch
workflows.description: Fetch SIEM events since the last pull time or last hour

step_variables._configuration_schema:
[
    {
        "title": "Event Type",
        "type": "select",
        "name": "eventType",
        "tooltip": "Select the event type you want to Ingest",
        "options": [
            "clicksPermitted",
            "messagesBlocked"
        ],
        "required": true,
        "editable": true,
        "visible": true,
        "value": "messagesBlocked"
    },
    {
        "title": "UseMock",
        "type": "checkbox",
        "name": "useMock",
        "tooltip": "Select if no DATA is available. Usefull for clicksPermitted Event.",
		"required": false,
        "visible": true,
        "editable": true,
        "value": false
    }
]
